description: The values one job-search filter accepts — skills, categories, seniorities, sources, countries and the rest — each with how many open postings carry it, most common first. A value not listed matches no posting. Use it before filtering on a value you are not sure of.

contains.description: keep only values containing this text, e.g. kube; for skills a known alias also finds its value, e.g. golang finds go

filter.description: a job-search filter: one of category, seniority, skills, work_mode, regions, countries, cities, sources, employment_type, english_level, relocation

limit.description: how many values to return, up to 200

name: list_filter_values

more.description: how many further values matched beyond this page

values.description: values carried by open postings, most common first, with how many carry each

title: List filter values
